objective: Narrow an enumerated runtime key before a keyof assertion and sum only the three own expense fields.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Structural interfaces, keyof and own-property checks remain current TypeScript/JavaScript.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Summing a named record while ignoring unrelated data is practical application work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Static assertions versus runtime ownership/allowed-key checks transfer to other typed object APIs.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Three known fields provide a bounded key-narrowing exercise.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Unchecked enumeration can include inherited or extra values despite the declared interface.

defects: Reference for-in included inherited and extra enumerable properties; Object.values senior included extra own keys.
Junior directly read fields rather than illustrating the authored for-in/keyof approach.
Hint incorrectly suggested an assertion proves a runtime property is an interface key.
The unchecked reference passed every original closed-literal example.
rationale: Guard own membership and allowed rent/food/travel names before asserting keyof in all instructional boards; retain direct-three-field reads as a valid faster alternative. Define stable ordinary/null-prototype data records, own required finite amounts, extra/inherited enumerable keys through1000 and bounded prototype depth. State ordinary Number rather than decimal-money arithmetic. Cases inspect frozen inherited/extra string/numeric keys, null-prototype __proto__/constructor extras,1000 keys and a fractional cancellation case with tolerance for ordinary addition-order rounding. O(n) counts visited enumerable keys for the taught guarded loop; the constant direct alternative is accepted.

O(n) includes list entries and own-field copying.

objective: Substitute only nullish values while preserving opaque identity and accurately describing an unconstrained generic result.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Nullish coalescing and generic unions remain current language foundations.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Defaulting configuration/data without replacing valid falsy values is practical work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Distinguishing a type parameter from NonNullable and preserving identity transfers to generic APIs.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: A constant-time branch is a focused foundational generic exercise.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: False non-null guarantees can lead to unsound downstream assumptions and runtime errors.

defects: Hint/approach said the answer can never be missing although unconstrained T may itself include null or undefined.
The shared-type sentence overstated rejection of different variants when callers can explicitly select a union.
JSON-cloning an object fallback passed all original structural checks.
Opaque identity and nullable/union instantiations were not verified.
rationale: Keep all three correct implementations and the public unconstrained signature. Correct the hint, approach and public label: T describes the result, and nullable T/fallback can still yield nullish output. Define synchronous exact-reference selection with no cloning/invocation/await; preserve functions, Symbols, Promises, NaN and signed zero. Runtime cases inspect all opaque branches, nullish fallback combinations and a10000-element untouched array. Hidden compiler checks accept nullable, undefined and explicit mixed unions and reject treating nullable output as string. Author constant wrapper cost; type-level work does not substitute for the runtime branch.
